npc.forager.name: Forest Wanderer
dialogue.forager.1: Welcome to the forest! Many kin live here. Weaken one in battle, then you can befriend it.
dialogue.forager.2: But stay alert — the shadepups hunt in packs further in.
dialogue.forager.3: And where the vines grow thick, they say something rare awaits ...
npc.mountaineer.name: Mountain Wanderer
dialogue.mountaineer.1: The mountain blocks the way ahead with heavy stone. Befriend a stoneback and it can smash through.
dialogue.mountaineer.2: Stonebacks are tough — be patient in battle, and they become loyal friends.
dialogue.mountaineer.3: And high up, the sparkits crackle. Stay clear of their lightning!
npc.bogkeeper.name: Swamp Wanderer
dialogue.bogkeeper.1: Mind yourself in the bog — the water runs deep, and creatures lurk in the mist.
dialogue.bogkeeper.2: To press on to the volcano, you need a friend who can freeze water into ice to walk on.
dialogue.bogkeeper.3: And if a friend can leap over water, something nice waits across the pool.
npc.emberkeeper.name: Volcano Wanderer
dialogue.emberkeeper.1: Lava flows here — build a bridge across it, or you will get burned.
dialogue.emberkeeper.2: Cindertails and emberpups are fast and fierce. Strike hard and fast.
dialogue.emberkeeper.3: An ancient plate lies buried here — a friend who digs tunnels will unearth it.
npc.snowkeeper.name: Snow Wanderer
dialogue.snowkeeper.1: The cold bites hard here. To reach the ruins, freeze the lake to ice and walk across.
dialogue.snowkeeper.2: Frostkits and gustlings rage in the blizzard — keep your team together.
dialogue.snowkeeper.3: Somewhere in the dark hides a glowing staff. Bring one who lights the way.
npc.ruinkeeper.name: Ruin Wanderer
dialogue.ruinkeeper.1: These ruins are ancient. The path to the castle lies in darkness — bring one who lights the way.
dialogue.ruinkeeper.2: Shadepups and sparkits guard the old halls.
dialogue.ruinkeeper.3: Cracked walls and sleeping runes hide treasures — the right friend reveals them.
npc.castellan.name: Castle Keeper
dialogue.castellan.1: You have reached the castle — the journey's end is near. The final trial waits in the depths.
dialogue.castellan.2: Auralings guard the holy halls; befriend one and it will charge your runes.
dialogue.castellan.3: Behind the old machine hides a final treasure — bring it to life.
